description: This file implements the Dictionary class for a text input method, providing functionalities such as suggestion generation, word validation, and internal data management for a dictionary used in an Android keyboard application.

classes.name: Dictionary
classes.description: A class that manages a dictionary for text suggestions, including methods for retrieving suggestions, validating words, and internal data handling.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Generates word suggestions based on input codes, output buffers, and various constraints.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a word to the internal suggestion list, maintaining order based on frequency and length.

methods.name: getChar
methods.description: Retrieves a character from the dictionary data at a given position.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves an address offset within the dictionary data.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts a character to its lowercase equivalent, considering base and extended character sets.

methods.name: sameAsTyped
methods.description: Checks if a word matches the input codes exactly.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word exists in the dictionary.
